intro.author: Not stated; the book tells a story about Jonah son of Amittai, a prophet from the time of Jeroboam II (2 Kings 14:25)
intro.written: Uncertain; proposals range from the 700s BC to after the exile
intro.audience: Israel, invited to see God's compassion for outsiders, including its enemies
intro.setting: Jonah prophesied in the northern kingdom in the 700s BC. Nineveh was a great city of Assyria, later the empire's capital, and Assyria was the most feared military power of the age; within decades it would destroy Israel's northern kingdom.
intro.purpose: To show that God's mercy reaches even Israel's enemies when they repent, and to expose the narrow heart of a prophet who wanted mercy for himself but not for them.
intro.bigIdea: God is 'gracious... and merciful,' even toward people we would rather see judged.
